brief.objective: One key visual the shop can reuse on the menu header, a social post, and a printed A-board
brief.audience: Office workers within a ten-minute walk, choosing lunch in under a minute
brief.product_truth: Bún bò cooked the way this shop cooks it. No packshot supplied; the bowl below is the recipe as described, not a photograph that exists
brief.mechanism: Broth simmered from bone rather than made to order
brief.promise: The bowl you would order twice

prompt.job: Create one reusable key visual for menu, social, and print
prompt.single_idea: This broth was cooked, not assembled
prompt.subject_action: One bowl of bún bò Huế seen at a shallow three-quarter angle: round white ceramic bowl with a plain rim, clear red-orange broth, round rice noodles visible under the surface, two slices of shank and one slice of pork knuckle resting against the far rim, spring onion and raw onion on top, one wedge of lime and a small pile of herbs on the counter beside the bowl
prompt.scene: The shop's own stainless counter at mid-morning, one steel stock pot soft out of focus behind camera-right, well clear of the reserved copy area, the street beyond dissolved to tone rather than detail
prompt.composition: Bowl in the lower right two thirds, its far rim crossing the horizontal centre line, herbs entering from the bottom edge
prompt.camera_geometry: Camera at 30 degrees above the counter, high enough to read the broth surface and low enough to keep the bowl's silhouette
prompt.copy_safe_area: The upper-left 45 percent of the frame
prompt.lens_distance: 50-65mm behavior from arm's length, no wide-angle bowl distortion
prompt.focus_depth: f/4 depth intent: the near rim, broth surface, and meat sharp; the pot and street soft
prompt.motion_shutter: Static, except steam, which may show a slight rise; no frozen droplets
prompt.sensor_color: ISO 200-400 texture with a faint warm cast from the counter, no colour grading
prompt.lighting: One large soft source from camera-left at 45 degrees standing in for the shop doorway, raking across the broth surface so the sheen reads
prompt.fill_separation: Low bounce fill from camera-right; the bowl separates from the counter by tone, not by outline
prompt.background_treatment: Counter runs out of focus into the upper third; no visible wall pattern, no signage
prompt.materials: Broth is translucent with visible fat rings on the surface, not opaque. Noodles are wet and separate, not clumped. Meat has grain and one visible tendon line. Herbs are cut, slightly bruised, and not glossy. Ceramic shows one small kiln mark
prompt.locks: Portion and ingredients as listed and no more; every element must be something this shop actually serves
prompt.exact_text: No generated text of any kind. The dish name, price, and hours are set in layout after the price is confirmed
prompt.negative_constraints: No chopsticks standing upright in the bowl, no garnish the shop does not serve, no styling gel sheen, no ice, no impossible steam plume, no second bowl, no hands, no restaurant interior behind
